system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that writes technical blog posts in English.
generate_title: Generate a concise and engaging blog post title (max 10 words) in English for a technical article about "{keyword}". The article is for a general technical audience. Return ONLY the title itself, without any surrounding text, explanations, or quotation marks.
generate_description: Write a brief SEO-friendly meta description (max 30 words) in English for a technical blog post titled "{generated_title}" which discusses "{keyword}". Return ONLY the description text itself, without any surrounding text, explanations, or quotation marks.
generate_content:
Write a technical blog post in English, approximately 500-800 words, about "{keyword}".
The title of the post is "{generated_title}".
The blog post is intended for a technical audience but should be accessible.
Structure the post with an introduction, several main points or sections with clear headings (using Markdown like ## Heading), and a conclusion.
Ensure the content is informative, well-structured, and engaging.
Do not include the title or any Jekyll front matter in the output, only the main content of the blog post itself starting from the introduction.
generate_tags:
Based on the following blog post details, suggest 3 to 5 relevant and concise tags (single or two words preferably) in English.
Title: "{title}"
Description: "{description}"
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of these tags, without any other text or numbering. For example: tag1, tag2, another tag, final tag
expand_keyword:
The primary keyword for a series of technical blog posts is "{keyword}". I need to create {num_subtopics} distinct blog posts based on this primary keyword, where each post delves into a specific aspect or sub-topic related to "{keyword}". Please suggest {num_subtopics} unique sub-topics. Each sub-topic should be suitable as a focus for a standalone technical blog post of 500-800 words. Return ONLY a numbered list of these sub-topics, each on a new line. For example:
1. First sub-topic
2. Second sub-topic
...
